span.p:
REGIONAL BY ROW — incidents · playbooks
each row is homed in the region that observed it,
in the CockroachDB-managed crdb_region column

div.style: color: rgb(5, 46, 22) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 700px; text-align: center;

span.p:
LOCALITY GLOBAL — institutional_playbooks · backtest_runs
written rarely, read by every region on every decision:
the exact access pattern GLOBAL exists for

div.style: color: rgb(15, 23, 42) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 700px; text-align: center;

span.p:
One serializable transaction spans all three
which is what makes SELECT … FOR UPDATE a correct
claim protocol against an at-least-once changefeed
rather than an optimistic guess

div.style: color: rgb(69, 10, 10) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 700px; text-align: center;

span.p:
a region is lost
quorum survives on the remaining two

div.style: color: rgb(69, 10, 10) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 700px; text-align: center;

span.p:
the open transaction still commits
no data loss, no maintenance window

div.style: color: rgb(15, 23, 42) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 700px; text-align: center;

span.p:
What is proven, and how
make region-config — reads the survival goal, the localities and
the real replica spread off the live Cloud cluster, 5/5 checks
make region-demo — a three-node cluster with one region locality
each, killed mid-transaction, because a managed cluster
offers no way to pull its own plug

svg.text: NEXUS — multi-region memory, and what each locality buys
